# hallpass_operator_identity (Resource)

Links a single sign-on identity (the provider's `sub` claim) to an operator, so that person signs in with that provider as the operator. HallPass matches single sign-on accounts only by issuer and subject, never by email. **Whoever controls this identity at the provider signs in as the operator**, so take the subject from the provider, not from the person. Destroying it unlinks the identity and ends the operator's single sign-on sessions. Import with `<operator_id>/<provider_id>/<subject>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Ada signs in with the company IdP; the subject is the IdP's `sub` claim for her account.
resource "hallpass_operator_identity" "ada" {
  operator_id = hallpass_operator.ada.id
  provider_id = hallpass_oidc_provider.company.id
  subject     = "00u1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `operator_id` (String) Operator ID (`opr_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `provider_id` (String) Single sign-on provider ID (`oidc_…`, from `hallpass_oidc_provider`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `subject` (String) The identity's `sub` claim at the provider. Changing it forces a new link.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<operator_id>/<issuer>/<subject>`.
- `issuer` (String) The provider's issuer URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <operator_id>/<provider_id>/<subject>
terraform import hallpass_operator_identity.ada opr_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j/oidc_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8k/00u1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9
```
